enumeration_note: Video 1 is a foundational/onboarding overview but teaches concrete, runnable ORB mechanics (defined levels, half/full range targets, half-range stop). Two distinct entry skeletons are taught: (1) the immediate breakout entry and (2) the pullback entry back to the pullback level after a breakout â€” genuinely different entry triggers per the under-split rule, hence two objects. The 5/15/30-minute ranges are timeframe variants within each. The pullback setup's exit is gestural ('entry back towards the long mark') so its exit levels remain unspecified beyond the shared range-target framework.

coaching_notes: Understanding the psychology of these breakouts really can help you transform your trading.
This one setup ... actually gives you plenty of opportunities ... throughout the entire trading day.

strategies.entry_summary: Let the opening range form over the first 5, 15, or 30 minutes after the 9:30 ET open (range high = level sellers defended, range low = level buyers defended). Enter on the breakout: long when price breaks above the opening range high, short when price breaks below the opening range low â€” the breakout direction is the initial directional conviction.
